item.title: Mythic C2 : Evading Advanced Detection Systems
item.description: This is the continuation of this article Advanced Detection Systems pose a real headache for red teamers (as they should), therefore I went looking for ways to circumvent EDRs and SIEMs and took a few steps that would help a lot in a real world engagement. But before we get started, let’s make sure that our payload isn’t detectable by AVs. Bypassing AVs Before anything, I checked my payload against the VirusTotal, as expected it was picked up by a couple of AV solutions :
